unit_basis.basis_note: unit indices refer to segment_units() over primary text; if basis_hash changes, historical anchors are interpreted against the basis they were cast under

transforms.operator_axis: assertion-axis — what the composition BEARS TO BE SAID (the presupposed conditions of the utterance, not the historical composer's biography); bilateral receptive operation (originary; most potent)

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, Cypris (a divine figure) saves both the poor and the king and protects a small city, with song living in written letters; in Text B, the unnamed uninvited one saves the poor and dishonored (removing the king/powerful), protects a narrow house instead of a city, and a stone monument endures instead of song in writing — the direction of divine protection shifts from encompassing the full social hierarchy and the civic/poetic realm to sheltering only the lowly and the private/material domain.
independent_verification.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies real structural changes — narrowing of divine protection from full social hierarchy to only the lowly, civic to private domain, song to stone monument — which are genuine relational mutations, but the declared claim focuses on the felicity conditions of the utterance (speaking from desperation, entreating uncertain power, expecting failure), a different structural reading than the hierarchy/domain shifts recovered.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B maintains the changed relation: 'τόδε λάϊνον ζώοι' (this stone endure) consistently replaces the civic-poetic 'μολπὰ γράμμασι ζώοι' (song live in letters), sustaining the shift to the private/material.

transforms.source_passage:
ἀλλὰ πᾶν τόλματον· ἐπεί σε, Κύπρι,
καὶ πένητα καὶ βασιλῆα σώζεις·
καὶ πόλιν ὀλίγαν ὑπερέχεις ἄτας·
     μολπὰ γράμμασι ζώοι.
transforms.enantiomorph:
ἀλλὰ πᾶν τόλματον· ἐπεί σε, τὰν ἄκλητον,
καὶ πένητα καὶ ἄτιμον σώζεις ποκα·
καὶ στενὸν τόδε δῶμα ὑπερέχεις ἄτας·
     τόδε λάϊνον ζώοι.

kernel.governing_law: The speaker stakes survival — personal, political, textual — on the fact that divine erotic power is indiscriminate in what it preserves, and that the written inscription is the vehicle of that preservation.
kernel.mutated_relation: The conditions that must hold for such an utterance to be spoken: the speaker stands at the threshold where daring is the only remaining option because preservation has not yet arrived — the indiscriminate power is entreated precisely because its exercise is uncertain, and the inscription exists because the voice expects to fail.
kernel.beats:
πᾶν τόλματον (all must be dared) -> the mouth empties its last breath forward
ἀλλά (but) -> ἀλλά (RETAIN: adversative turn is the structural hinge between exhaustion and appeal)
ἐπεί (since) -> ἐπεί (RETAIN: the causal joint must hold; the logic of desperation requires it)
σε (you) -> the unverified
Κύπρι (Kypris/Aphrodite) -> you-whose-arrival-I-cannot-compel
πένητα (the poor man) -> the one with nothing to trade
βασιλῆα (the king) -> the one whose trade-goods are worthless here
σώζεις (you save) -> you have sometimes carried across
καί...καί (both...and) -> whether...or
πόλιν ὀλίγαν (a small city) -> this narrowing room
ὑπερέχεις (you hold above) -> you have held above before
ἄτας (ruin) -> the floor giving way
μολπά (song) -> this cut into stone
γράμμασι (in letters) -> because the throat will close
ζώοι (may it live) -> let it outlast the breath that fails
